metadata.title: SSi Grammar Quality Analysis - Comprehensive Report

methodology.sample_size: 20 USE phrases per course (160 total phrases analyzed)

executive_summary.headline: High quality grammar with minor naturalness issues in some courses
key_findings: Known language (L1) quality is excellent across all courses: 86.2/100 average
Target language (L2) quality is good but varies by course: 78.4/100 average
25 total grammar/naturalness issues found across 160 phrases (15.6% error rate)
Most issues are related to NATURALNESS rather than grammar correctness
English phrases show systematic preposition issues ('speak with' vs 'speak to')
Arabic and German courses show the strongest overall quality
Breton course has some orthographic inconsistencies
executive_summary.recommendation: Overall quality is strong. Focus improvements on naturalness and idiomatic usage, particularly in English target phrases. Address systematic preposition patterns.

main_issues: Systematic preposition issues: 'speak with you' instead of 'speak to you'
Unnatural standalone phrases like 'I want.' without objects
Redundant pronouns in Arabic creating unnecessary emphasis
strengths: Arabic grammar is excellent and well-structured
specific_recommendations: Replace 'speak with' with 'speak to' or 'talk with' throughout
Ensure standalone verb phrases have appropriate context
Review Arabic pronoun usage for beginner appropriateness

deu_for_eng.note: AI analysis encountered JSON parsing error - requires manual review
deu_for_eng.action_required: Re-run analysis or perform manual linguistic review

main_issues: One minor dialectal variation in vowel marking
strengths: Excellent grammatical accuracy in both languages
specific_recommendations: Verify consistency of dialectal choices (MSA vs colloquial)

strengths: Perfect grammatical accuracy in both languages

specific_recommendations: Consider this course as a quality benchmark for others

common_issues.recommendation: Review all English phrases for preposition naturalness; consider 'speak to' or 'talk with' depending on context
Systematically review mutation rules and apply consistently; consider automated validation

conclusion.grade_justification: Average score of B+ (86.2/78.4) reflects high grammatical accuracy with room for improvement in naturalness and idiomaticity. Most issues are minor and easily addressable.
conclusion.sample_representativeness: 20 phrases per course provides good coverage of early content; recommend periodic full-course audits
next_steps: Address immediate HIGH priority items (English prepositions, German course re-analysis)
Schedule native speaker reviews for Celtic languages
Implement automated validation for future content
Re-audit in 3 months after fixes applied
conclusion.final_note: The SSi course content demonstrates strong linguistic quality overall. The identified issues are systematic and addressable through targeted fixes and improved QA processes. The high grammatical accuracy provides a solid foundation for learners.
